column1: # THE DESIGN RULES TABLE (CLAUDE.md, "Design rules" and "Code quality ratchets"): ONE table of the rules every language
# is held to -- Scala, Python and JS/TS -- read by the general rule core (scripts/design-rules/, design_check.py) and by
# each language's measure (scripts/py-quality-report, scripts/js-quality-report; the Scala constants are checked equal
# to it by scripts/design-rules/rules_table_test.py). Loosening a row -- a limit raised, an adapter or an allowed idiom
# added, a layer moved up -- lands only with the kind's trailer (`Complexity:`, `Length:`, `Duplication:`, `Coupling:`,
#   limit<TAB><kind><TAB><value><TAB><languages>         a measure's limit (every language listed holds it)
#   suffix<TAB><word>                                   a name may not END in it (CLAUDE.md: "Never suffix a class with Impl")
#   abbreviation<TAB><word>                             a word of a name that is an abbreviation of a real word
#   idiom<TAB><word>                                    a language-standard idiom, allowed although it abbreviates
#   adapter<TAB><language><TAB><module><TAB><effects>    a module allowed to touch these effects directly (clock,
#                                                       process, env): every other module receives them
#   distance<TAB><language><TAB><directory>             a directory whose distance D is measured: only where
#                                                       abstractions exist (Protocol/ABC; plain browser JS has none)
#   layer<TAB><language><TAB><directory><TAB><rank><TAB><why>   a directory's rank, bottom (0) up: a module may import
#                                                       only from its own rank or a lower one; a directory with no row
#                                                       places nothing (a new directory takes its row in its commit)
# The limits (the Scala quality module's and project/Coupling.scala's own; 2026-11-20 tightening):
# The data guard (data holding logic is a collaborator; 2026-11-26; Scala's own: project/Coupling.scala's DataMethodCut,
# DataDecisionCut, DefaultDataBagLimit, DefaultDataFanOutLimit, checked equal to these by design_check_test.py): a data type with more non-trivial methods or
# decisions than these is a collaborator; one naming more types a `databag` row; a module using more data types a
# Naming (CLAUDE.md: "Never suffix a class with Impl"; Manager/Handler/Util/Helper/Processor are a smell; "no
# The idioms allowed (the owner, 2026-11-26): `args`, `kwargs`, `self`, `e` for events, `i`/`j` loop indexes, `ctx` only
# where a library names it -- names checked here are types, modules and top-level functions, where none of the
# The adapters: the modules that touch the clock, a process or the environment for everyone else.
# Distance D: where abstractions exist (the owner, 2026-11-26): the Python library packages and the TypeScript
# dashboard. Plain browser JS (web/src/main/assets/js) has none, so D measures nothing there: cycles and layers hold it.
# The layers (ranks, bottom up), Python: the shared library under the tools, the tools and gates over it (scripts/ and
# scripts/ci use each other: their cycle is a frozen `dircycle` row), every other tool collection over those, and the
# general rule core over the quality measure it reads.
